title: Austin Yacht Charter Experience on Lake Travis
blurb:
A uniquely immersive experience with a focus on all things wellness and water. The company concept is a beautifully balanced marriage of leisure cruising alongside embracing the rejuvenating and calming effects of the water. 

Designed with the guest in mind. Tastefully appointed and decorated with art by local Austin artists, this yacht cruise experience truly stands out. If you are ready to disconnect from tech and reconnect with your inner zen, this is the experience for you. You will enjoy plush modern seating and accommodations, spa towels, healthy plated snacks and meals, and nautical-themed dinnerware service with Italian silverware. 

Meals are prepared by a well-trained private chef and you can select from fresh juice infused waters, espresso, teas, and more.
